inputs.description: Source-selected spatial-cell spiking/firing activity is the decoder input; synchronized VR track angle is the target. Preserve original RF input window, cell-selection and map eligibility.

metric.description: Decoder score is the mean of cos(true track angle minus predicted angle) over original test observations; higher is better, with 1 for perfect prediction.

aggregation.description: Average the ten decoder scores within each original session, then retain separate young and aged stratum summaries. Source Figure 5i uses the both-map/random-selection score; no pooled scalar is substituted.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure 5i session-averaged cosine position-decoding score, preserving the young/aged comparison vector
